summary: fix(shared-cms): read operation names with graphql getOperationAST
description:
Because:

- Apollo Client 4 moved getOperationName out of @apollo/client/utilities into an internal, unstable entry point.

This commit:

- Reads the operation name for CMS metric and log tags with graphql's public getOperationAST.
- Passes a real parsed query in the metering and relying-party specs instead of mocking getOperationName.
